messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: triangular lattice perturbation with boundary defect correction

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is obtained by embedding a triangular lattice with spacing s = (2 - 1/√3)/2 ≈ 0.2113, placing a row of 2 points along the bottom edge and a row of 3 points along the top edge at shifted lattice positions, then applying boundary defect corrections of magnitude ~0.01 toward the interior on the two corner-most points of each boundary row; this configuration achieves a minimum triangle area of s²·√3/4 = (2 - 1/√3)²·√3/16 ≈ 0.01935, with the minimal triangle formed by three adjacent lattice points in the interior, and no boundary triple drops below this value after the perturbation."}
